title: Part 8
content_zh: 'On the bathing-tub of Tang, the following words were engraved: If you can one day renovate yourself, do so from day to day. Indeed, let there be daily renovation.' So it was with Tang, and so it must be with every person who seeks to follow the Way.
content_en: 'On the bathing-tub of Tang, the following words were engraved: If you can one day renovate yourself, do so from day to day. Indeed, let there be daily renovation.' So it was with Tang, and so it must be with every person who seeks to follow the Way.
